get_task_instance: use AutoTask.get to instantiate a task class by name with seed and sample parameters
load_datasets: call load_datasets on a task instance to load GLUE or SuperGLUE datasets from HuggingFace
sample_datasets: call sample_datasets to split training data into balanced train and validation sets by label
get_datasets: call get_datasets on a task instance to load, sample, and post-process datasets in one step
create_custom_task: subclass AbstractTask to define a new few-shot NLP task with custom dataset loading logic
